stories.title: Jodar Stuns Ruud to Reach First Masters 1000 Semifinal in Shanghai

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Rafael Jodar stuns Casper Ruud 4-6, 6-4, 6-3. His first ATP Masters 1000 semifinal. He dropped the first set. Again. He won anyway. Again. The Cinderella run in Shanghai continues. #ShanghaiMasters #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Jodar is in the Shanghai semis and his ATP Finals hopes are very much alive. He's beaten van de Zandschulp, Lehecka, and now Ruud — always from behind. That's the kind of week that changes careers. #ShanghaiMasters #Tennis

stories.title: Kartal Shocks World No. 6 Svitolina to Reach First WTA 1000 Semifinal

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: SONAY KARTAL BEATS ELINA SVITOLINA. World No. 170 vs. World No. 6 — and the qualifier wins 6-2, 2-6, 6-4. Kartal has never beaten a Top 10 player before today. She just did it in a WTA 1000 quarterfinal. #WuhanOpen #Tennis

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: A British qualifier. Ranked No. 170 in the world. First WTA 1000 semifinal. Sonay Kartal just had the best day of her career and she's not done yet. Ostapenko awaits. #WuhanOpen #Tennis
